description: Bilan actif CCO du groupe SNCF Réseau depuis 2015 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Bilan actif depuis 2015 issu des Rapports Financiers du groupe SNCF Réseau au 31 décembre de chaque année (Comptes consolidés incluant l'EPIC SNCF RESEAU et ses filiales). Coverage: France. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Comptes Consolidés, Bilan, Actif. The portal shows 2022-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
